text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Sky... I shall prove my worth against 
my peer from the Classic route. 
Yet, I must not become obsessed with 
that.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I do not run out of envy or jealousy. 
I shall face Sky—simply as myself.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(As an umamusume who claimed the Tiara. 
As the harbinger of our beautiful Club—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list:
Give them a run that future generations 
will yearn for!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leave it to me. 
And while I am at it—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I shall set your heart ablaze as well.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you made it. 
Good to see ya today~

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I will sweep through you all. 
Brace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. As fiery as ever, aren't ya, 
Phaleno-chan?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Still, I don't intend to back down either.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sei-chan doesn't really have some grand 
"reason to run" like you do, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes that just makes you lighter on 
your feet—and stronger.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Allow me to show you that firsthand☆
